'''Jesper Larsson''' of Malmö, Sweden, finished 36th at the [[2000 Decipher World Championship]] Day 2 (8 (−13)). The DecipherCon 2000 qualifier list names him as the Toola qualifier.<ref name="dc00fin">[http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html DecipherCon 2000: Star Wars CCG Qualifiers], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010308110320/http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html Internet Archive]</ref>
